meta_page_description: Find the latest updates and release notes for Glyflict.
page_title_v00_note: v0.0 Release Notes   Glyflict | Free to Play
TeamBattle_text: The main game mode is a 6v6 team battle. Work together with your teammates and be the first team to reach 100 eliminations!
alt_kanji_weapon_image: In-game image of the Hana and Yaiba loadouts
KanjiWeapon_text: At the start of each battle, random kanji characters are selected as your equipment. Each kanji is divided into three parts, each of which can be used as a powerful weapon or skill!
KanjiWeapon_text2: The following six kanji are available in version 0.0.
alt_kanji_hikari_image: Image of the kanji for Hikari
alt_kanji_hana_image: Image of the kanji for Hana
alt_kanji_miizu_image: Image of the kanji for Mizu
alt_kanji_yaiba_image: Image of the kanji for Yaiba
alt_kanji_tsuki_image: Image of the kanji for Tsuki
alt_kanji_hi_image: Image of the kanji for Hi
KanjiWeapon_text3: Play the game to discover what kinds of skills each kanji can create!
KanjiWeapon_text4: More kanji will be added in future updates.
KanjiMastery_text: Each kanji has a unique ability that helps you in battle. Earn XP through eliminations, assists, and match victories to level up its mastery and enhance its unique ability!
alt_head_vital_shot_image: Gameplay image showing a Headshot and a Vital Shot
HeadVitalShot_text: Hitting an enemy's head triggers a "Headshot," while hitting their core triggers a "Vital Shot." Headshots deal increased damage to shields, while Vital Shots deal massive damage to HP!
Map_text: A map is randomly selected for each battle. Drop into a strategic location and gain the upper hand in combat!
GenesisChallenge1_text: Take on challenges that offer a different experience from regular battles. Clear all 20 challenges to unlock the exclusive Robot-Cold Steel skin!
alt_coldsteel_image: Image of the Robot-Cold Steel skin
FCP_text: The Founder's Cosmetic Pack DLC is now available! Get exclusive skins, wraps, and accessories to customize your look and stand out in battle.
alt_fcp_image: Thumbnail image of the Founder's Cosmetic Pack DLC
